advice.OK: Nothing to do. The next backup runs automatically.
advice.OLD: The computer was probably off or asleep at backup time. Press "Back up now".
advice.LOCAL_ONLY: Google Drive did not accept it. Check your internet connection, then press "Back up now".
advice.AGENT_OFFLINE: Start the system again with start.command. If this stays, ask your helper.
advice.TOO_OLD: Press "Back up now". If it does not work, ask your helper.
advice.FAILED: Press "Back up now" to try again. If it fails again, ask your helper.
advice.NEVER: Press "Back up now" to make the first backup.

drive.title: Google Drive
drive.connected: Connected. Every backup is also saved to your Google Drive.
drive.notConnected: Not connected. Backups are kept only on this computer — if the computer is lost or broken, they are lost too.
drive.step1: In the Supun Construction folder, open the "scripts" folder.
drive.step2: Double-click "setup-gdrive.command". A black Terminal window opens.
drive.step3: Your browser shows a Google page. Choose the Google account for the backups.
drive.step4: If Google says the app is not verified, click "Advanced", then "Go to rclone". Then click "Continue" or "Allow".
drive.step5: When the page says "Success", close it. Come back here and press "Back up now" to test.
drive.privacy: The backup tool can only see the files it creates. Backups are locked with your backup password, so nobody can open them without it.

password.title: Keep your backup password safe
password.text: Backups are locked with the backup password shown when the system was first started (also in the .env file). Write it on paper and keep it safe. Without it, no backup can be restored.
